video.title: Fantasy Basketball Mock Draft - 9 Cat H2H Pick 1 [Jokic Build]

summary: Josh Lloyd runs a 12-team, 9-category head-to-head mock draft from pick 1 and opens with Nikola Jokic. He follows with Anthony Davis, Darius Garland, Jaylen Brown, Franz Wagner, Ryan Rollins and Brandin Podziemski, then several upside flyers in the later rounds. His ideal top six is Jokic, Wembanyama, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Luka Doncic, Giannis and Tatum. He thinks Cade Cunningham, Tyrese Maxey and Tyrese Haliburton carry some risk. His main principles: perfect builds don't exist, don't lean too hard on pairing players, value depends on the pick slot, and save flyers for the later rounds. His team finished first in the projected standings.
